english.title: Holder of suspended London PHV licence fail return driver's badge - London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a London private hire vehicle driver's licence and that licence having been suspended under powers conferred by section 16 of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998, you failed to return the

(A)_[licence]_
(B)_[badge]_

within seven days of being served with a notice issued by

(C)_[the Secretary of State]_
(D)_[a police constable]_
(E)_[an authorised officer]_

directing you to return

(F)_[it]_
(G)_[them]_

to

(H)_[him]_
(I)_[her]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 22(4), (5) and (6) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

In the case of a continuing offence, to a fine not exceeding ten pounds for each day during which an offence continues after conviction.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
